title: CI: add Ubuntu 24.04 (kernel 6.8) to test matrix
description: UBUNTU_VERSION=24.04 support already exists in test-on-aws.sh but is not run as a standard target. Add it to the matrix so kernel 6.8 is covered alongside 5.15.
close_reason: Ubuntu 24.04 (kernel 6.17) passes 19/0. Fixed AMI pattern: hvm-ssd-gp3 (Noble moved away from hvm-ssd).
